## Gaps

- No second-half cash flow bridge, remaining Bay Minette spend or date of normal capacity is supplied, so the guided return to positive free cash flow in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2027 cannot be tested against a budget. Severity: Medium. The action is the issuer's capital and cash flow plan for the second half.
Basis: EX-99.1_2026-11-05_novelisq2fy27results.htm.jsonl, page 3; 10-Q_2026-09-30_nvl-20260930.htm.jsonl, pages 48, 65

- The June 2026 revolver amendment, the borrowing base and the fixed charge ratio are not supplied, so the trigger for the minimum fixed charge ratio rests on the earlier annual report wording and covenant headroom is not calculable. Severity: Medium. The action is the amended credit agreement and a compliance certificate.

- The nature of the security that AV Minerals (Netherlands) N.V. and Novelis Italia S.p.A. provide as third party security providers under the revolver agreement is not described in the notes, so whether the shareholder has pledged its shares or given other support is not established; this qualifies the earlier reading that the only parent support stated is equity paid in. Severity: Medium. The action is the executed revolver agreement and security documents.
Basis: 10-K_2026-03-31_nvl-20260331.htm.jsonl, pages 148, 208; Business & governance (CP-1A)

- No agency rating, market price, spread or peer set is supplied, so ratings triggers, relative value and the comparison with typical sector issuers are not established; the rating-linked terms found are a margin step on the 2026 term loan and a covenant suspension at investment grade. Severity: Low for this module. The action is to supply the inputs if those analyses are wanted.
Basis: 10-Q_2026-09-30_nvl-20260930.htm.jsonl, pages 20–21; Source readiness (CP-0)

- Insurance policy limits, deductibles and the expected amount and timing of further recoveries are not stated, and the estimate of about USD 1.7 billion of negative cash flow dates from the annual report with no later update, so the recoverable share of the fire cost is not established. Severity: Medium. The action is the issuer's insurance schedule.

- Cash interest paid is printed for fiscal years only, so interim interest cover is an expense-based proxy on interest, net and not a cash measure; Financial foundation built no interim cover, and this proxy adds to its fiscal-year cash cover without replacing it. Severity: Low. The action is interim cash interest disclosure.
Basis: 10-K_2026-03-31_nvl-20260331.htm.jsonl, page 112; EX-99.1_2026-11-05_novelisq2fy27results.htm.jsonl, page 8; calculation C13

- The printed principal ladder shows USD 566 million in the second year, yet the dated instrument table places the 2026 term loan facility of USD 500 million (July 2028) and the Sierre loan of USD 120 million (October 2027) in that period, a total of USD 620 million before any amortization, and the third-year bucket of USD 733 million is USD 138 million larger than the dated instruments in that period, USD 595 million before amortization; the difference is consistent with the ladder placing the Sierre loan a year later than its stated maturity, which the filings do not explain. The wall by calendar year in this answer uses the instrument dates, and the ladder is quoted only for the first-year bucket. Severity: Low. The action is the issuer's debt maturity schedule by instrument.
Basis: 10-Q_2026-09-30_nvl-20260930.htm.jsonl, pages 17, 21; 10-K_2026-03-31_nvl-20260331.htm.jsonl, page 152; calculation C22; calculation C30

- Committed availability of USD 155 million outside the ABL Revolver is not itemised by facility, although the cash flow statements show a Korea and a China credit facility, so liquidity by facility is complete only for the revolver. Severity: Low. The action is a facility-level availability schedule.
Basis: 10-Q_2026-09-30_nvl-20260930.htm.jsonl, pages 19, 61, 64; calculation C04

- Confirmed supplier invoices are stated in billions at interim dates and the programme sizes by bank are not stated, so the exact September 30, 2026 balance and the headroom of the programmes are not established. Severity: Medium, because the float is outside debt and could shrink. The action is a roll-forward of confirmed obligations.

- Business & governance noted that customer concentration beyond one customer above 10% of sales was not stated. The annual report does state that the ten largest customers took 57% of fiscal 2026 net sales against 41% a year earlier, so that gap is partly filled and the 16 percentage point rise, which the earlier answer did not carry, is a concentration risk this answer adds; the ranking of the other nine customers is still not stated. Basis: 10-K_2026-03-31_nvl-20260331.htm.jsonl, pages 33, 188; Business & governance (CP-1A); calculation C23
